title: Tbjp inspired high intensity
author: Edmund  L.
desc:
Novice and intermediate level programme for blokes who wish to try high intensity, lower volume full body 3/4 day split.

Can do either 
Mon, Wed, Fri and Sat or
Mon, Tue, Thurs and Sat or
Mon, Wed, Fri and Sun, then following week would be Tue, Thurs, Sat, and Mon.

Can swap to rack pulls if this stalls, due to DL being hard for higher reps
